observation.precondition: D1 displayed all three liveness lines, then E25 on a red frame without a prompt
observation.read_session: tuple first, then only the listed physical Bank-0 ranges in the same stopped session

code_rule: Bind the sampled PC to bytes in the captured CPU view before assigning a symbol.
data_rule: Read the listed state as physical Bank-0 RAM after capturing the mapping tuple; a raw ROM-overlaid logical read is not evidence.

decision_rows.decoder-failure: error is nonzero, or the successful-decode tuple is absent before roots are committed; report phase/error/provenance only.
decision_rows.export-publication-failure: phase=13, finished=1, error=0 and pending/committed roots equal c2_runtime.c2_root_count while c2_ready=0; mem_oom and journal_count further split allocation from structural publication failure.
decision_rows.identity-or-visibility-red: pending_code is not 0x25, the runtime pointer/layout contradicts the bound ELF, or physical and mapped reads disagree; make no decoder or publication claim.
decision_rows.ambiguous: make no product-mechanism claim and return the one complete row to the owner.

claim_limit: This specification authorizes no device access, repeat boot, product fix, D2-D5 execution or E25 submechanism claim.
